$comment: Psi's look on the sign-in (Authentik, auth.psizone.ro): which token of psi's design system plays each role the sign-in stylesheet paints with. Read by SEB's packages/rmx-ui/scripts/authentik-assets.mjs (setting SIGNIN_THEME); every value comes from the token file as written. Light is Psizone Gold, dark is Psizone Night. The ground is psi's ambient field (packages/ui/src/components.css .pz-ambient, intensity low: opacity 0.32, x0.8 in light) at rest. Regenerate from a SEB checkout (branch SEB-authentik-estate-theme or later) with psi's whitelabel config in place: ESTATE_CONFIG=<psi>/brand/estate.config.json ESTATE_STYLESHEET=<psi>/brand/estate.css SIGNIN_THEME=<psi>/brand/signin-theme.json node packages/rmx-ui/scripts/authentik-assets.mjs, then copy recomex.css, fundal*.svg, logo-*.svg, mail-logo.png and sources.json into gitops/platform/authentik/estate/.
